recap.text: Drick is a former crawler and a member of the Dream. He brags on a CrawlCon panel about the state of the crawl. He carries a Gondii worm in his brain for the Valtay.

Odette presents three adjutant candidates to the court, including Drick, a bald Dream elf. Drick is a former crawler with a Valtay worm in his brain for life extension. Donut says she does not like him and asks about tanning salons.

Juice Box attempts to decapitate Drick in the Desperado Club, but her blade passes through him like a ghost. She reports a Valtay worm in his brain and notes that NPCs cannot kill him. Drick enters the Posse's forward trench beside Baroness Victory to watch the assault and offers to warn the other side.

beats.headline: Crawling Through the Ages
beats.text: Subject is a former crawler and a member of the Dream, appearing on a CrawlCon panel on the current state of the crawl. He is also carrying a Gondii worm in his brain on behalf of the Valtay, which is a detail the panel does not cover. He brags well. It is the part of him that is still his own.
beats.gist: Drick is a former crawler and Dream member who brags on a CrawlCon panel.

beats.headline: The candidate with a worm in him
beats.text: Subject is a bald Dream elf, one of three adjutant candidates Odette puts in front of the court, and a recipient of a Valtay life extension: the original Drick was a crawler, and this iteration carries a Valtay worm in the brain. He has recently passed the referee exam and has never served as an adjutant. The cat says she does not like him and asks about tanning salons. The lawyer gives him a tepid thumbs down. The crawler asks whether a Valtay may even do this. It is unusual, Odette allows.
beats.gist: Drick is a bald Dream elf with a Valtay worm in his brain.

beats.headline: The blade goes through him
beats.text: Subject is present in the Desperado Club as adjutant to Team Retribution. Juice Box reports that she touched his arm and found it solid, and that when she attempted to decapitate him her blade passed through him like a ghost. The protection a crawler has for a while after regenerating appears, in his case, to be permanent. She also reports a worm in his brain, of a different species from the one in Carl's rock friend. Carl names it: a Valtay worm. The NPCs are not allowed to kill him.
beats.gist: Drick is an adjutant to Team Retribution in the Desperado Club with a permanent regeneration protection.

beats.headline: Watching from the trench
beats.text: Subject, adjutant for Team Retribution, cracks into the Posse's forward trench beside Baroness Victory, causing some moments of bedlam until Carl shouts everyone down. Team Retribution is taking a small part in this assault, he explains sheepishly, so he has come to watch from the best position. Told he will see nothing from there, he offers to go across and warn the other side instead. The offer is not taken up.
beats.gist: Drick, an adjutant for Team Retribution, cracks into the Posse's forward trench beside Baroness Victory.
